title: Power Automate: desktop flow libraries of reusable subflows
summary: The roadmap dates and template comparisons are supported. However, Microsoft has not established that no administrator action is required, that existing unattended flows can change only when their maker adds a library, or that environment maker access controls library use. Remove those assurances while library defaults and permissions remain undocumented.

claims.claim: Publishing an updated template does not update flows already created from it.
claims.quote: Publishing an updated template makes the updated version available for future flows. Existing flows created from the template aren't updated.

claims.claim: Template recipients with co-owner permissions can edit the template.

claims.claim: Template recipients with user permissions have read-only access.
claims.quote: A template shared with user permissions is available as read-only.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center documents environment feature settings for other desktop flow capabilities, without stating that those settings govern libraries.
claims.quote: You can find these settings in the Power Platform admin center for an environment. ... Enable storage of desktop flow files into v2 schema. ... Allow connection embedding for desktop flows.

claims.claim: Until library-specific documentation appears, control over libraries sits with who is given maker access to an environment.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" connections credentials sharing permissions version storage; Power Automate desktop flows libraries data policies environment maker access unattended existing flows. Read Manage security for Power Automate; it does not establish library access requirements.
claims.fix: Remove 'Until Microsoft says otherwise, control sits with who is given maker access to an environment.' The general Environment maker role documentation does not establish library permissions.

claims.claim: A flow that already runs unattended would only change if its maker adds a library to it.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" "unattended" "existing". Read roadmap and search excerpts from Manage desktop flows and Run unattended desktop flows; no passage guarantees existing flows change only when their maker adds a library.
claims.fix: Replace 'A flow that already runs unattended would only change if its maker adds a library to it.' with 'The roadmap does not describe any change to existing unattended flows.'

claims.claim: No administrator action is required.
claims.quote: Searched: "desktop flow libraries" "admin" "action"; "desktop flow libraries" enable disable tenant environment setting default rollout. Read roadmap and Manage feature settings; neither says no administrator action is required.
claims.fix: Replace '; no admin action is required' with '; Microsoft has not stated whether admin enablement is required'. Keep defaultState as unknown.

claims.fix: Add 'Introduction to desktop flows' (https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/desktop-flows/introduction) to sources for the general files-and-applications automation premise.
